_about: Derived EV-bridge values for the pins (2026-10-09): each case's CIQ TEV build-up, CIQ's own current TEV less market cap, the consensus net-debt check and the exit default, built by vinci.dossier.ciq_sheets.ev_bridge from the Financials, Estimates and comps exports named by hash. Derived values only — the workbooks are never committed.
